summary: Cotabato 1st District representative with 103 principal-authored bills. Authored amendments to the Magna Carta of Public Health, food warning labels, the national minimum wage, crop-insurance expansion and an anti-dynasty ban.
caveat: Anti-dynasty is a single democratic issue and was left unscored. Economic evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored national minimum wage (-2), public health worker Magna Carta amendments (-2), food warning labels (-2) and expanded state crop insurance (-2). No tax-side or privatization evidence.
